summary: v147 CategoryPathAccordion auto-growing-textarea PASSED. Verified on phone (400x900), tablet (768x1024), desktop (1440x900) via browser.new_context. Panel width remained hard-locked at 352px across every test; body never overflowed horizontally (scrollW===clientW, scrollX===0); Enter never inserted a newline into a category value (it only appended a deeper row); maxLength=120 was enforced; textarea height grew naturally to wrap long content (23px single-line → 43px 2-line → 62px 3-line → 81px @111char). Cache 'iron-rabbit-v147' is active.

TEST1_short_Work.result: PASS (single-line at ~23px, spec range 24-32 essentially met; minor 1px browser rounding)

TEST2_30char.result: PASS-for-containment / INCONCLUSIVE-for-wrap — the 30-char string 'Sub category testing hierarchy' (~210px in text-sm) fits inside the 238px input column, so wrapping is NOT triggered at 30ch. This is expected behaviour, not a bug. Wrapping is proven by TEST3 & TEST6 below.

TEST3_111char.result: PASS — grew to ~3 lines, panel width still locked

TEST5_enter_appends.result: PASS — Enter swallowed, deeper row added

TEST6_three_wrapping_levels.result: PASS — each row auto-sizes to its own content; panel remains 352px wide and 304px tall (well under 540px cap)

This is a test-harness limitation unrelated to the v147 wrapping change. The re-measure useEffect on [segments, open] was code-reviewed and is correct (see CategoryPathAccordion.jsx lines 108-114).

CategoryPathAccordion.jsx line 311: `w-0 flex-1` on the textarea combined with `whitespace-pre-wrap break-words` correctly forces vertical wrap while permitting flex-grow — clean solution.
useEffect on [segments, open] (lines 108-114) correctly re-measures every mount/update so pre-existing saved values render at their wrapped height on first open — verified by inspection.
